item_prototype.name: Container CPU Throttle Periods
item_prototype.description: Number of CPU Throttling enforcement intervals that have elapsed

item_prototype.name: Number of Times Container CPU Throttled on {#CONTAINERNAME}
item_prototype.description: The number of times the CPU has been throttled by Docker Restrictions.

item_prototype.name: Number of times Memory Limit hit on {#CONTAINERNAME}
item_prototype.description: Number of times memory usage hit limits

item_prototype.name: Memory Limit on {#CONTAINERNAME}
item_prototype.description: Memory limit of the cgroup in bytes

trigger_prototype.name: CPU Throttled on Container: {#CONTAINERNAME} more than 10 times in 1 Hour
trigger_prototype.description: The CPU limit has been hit consistently for the last hour - if this is impacting the performance of the container it may be worth increasing/removing this limit.

trigger_prototype.name: Memory Limit on Container: {#CONTAINERNAME} hit more than 10 times in 1 Hour
trigger_prototype.description: The memory limit has been hit consistently for the last hour - if this is impacting the performance of the container it may be worth increasing/removing this limit.

trigger_prototype.name: More than {$PIDS} Processes running on Container {#CONTAINERNAME}
trigger_prototype.description: There are more processes than expected running on this container - it may be worth checking

trigger_prototype.name: {#CONTAINERNAME} Not Running for Last 5 Minutes
trigger_prototype.description: A container has been stopped for 5 minutes

trigger.expression: {Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:containers.total.last(5)}>{Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:containers.total.last()}
trigger.recovery_expression: {Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:containers.total.last(60)}={Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:containers.total.last()}
trigger.name: A Container has been Removed on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: The number of Containers has decreased in the last 5 minutes

trigger.expression: {Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:docker.totals[image].last()}-{Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:docker.stat[VOLACT].last()}>5
trigger.recovery_expression: {Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:docker.totals[image].last()}-{Template - OS - Linux - CoreOS - V0.04:docker.stat[VOLACT].last()}<6
trigger.name: More than 5 Unused Volumes on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: Consider Running docker prune to clear the clutter

trigger.name: More Than 50% Space Available to Reclaim from Containers on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: More than 50% of the space used by Containers can be reclaimed. Consider using docker prune

trigger.name: More Than 50% Space Available to Reclaim from Images on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: More than 50% of the space used by Images can be reclaimed. Consider using docker prune

trigger.name: More Than 50% Space Available to Reclaim from Volumes on {HOST.NAME}
trigger.description: More than 50% of the space used by Volumes can be reclaimed. Consider using docker prune
